# Spite

> Spite is a small, opinionated language meant to be written mostly by AI and skimmed by humans. It compiles to C,
> its compiler is written in Spite and compiles itself, and the compiler is also its formatter and linter: it never
> warns, and every error names the fix. You write the readable version; the compiler fuses, specialises and
> tree-shakes it into the fast one.

Before writing Spite, load the skill: it is the whole language on one page, with the habits from other languages
the compiler rejects.

## Start here

- [Why Spite](WHY.md#if-you-are-a-language-model): what it does for you, and how to write it
- [The Spite skill](skills/spite/SKILL.md): instructions for writing Spite
- [The whole language on one page](skills/spite/reference.md): every rule the compiler enforces
